svg.title: Повороты шеи в комфортной амплитуде — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Gentle cervical rotation. Straight front view of both entire figures, shoulders and chest square forward, arms down. LEFT only head turns modestly about 30 degrees to viewer left. RIGHT only head turns about 30 degrees to viewer right. Chin stays level, both shoulders in identical position, no torso rotation or neck tilt. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
